text:
amanda_sales: Hey team — Catalyst Labs (seed, YC W20) asking for a special startup grant: 90 days extended trial + $20k usage credit and SSO onboarding support. They want to run a POC that looks like low qps but heavy token volume. Can we approve outside standard program?

mike_ae: quick context — founders are building an LLM-driven search for regulated docs. They asked sales for longer window because their compliance SSO delays onboarding. Good logos potential, but low initial ARR.

josh_se: what does security need to sign off on for SSO? Are they asking for private deployment or just SAML to hosted?

amanda_sales: just SAML into hosted for now. No private infra. But they asked caller says legal needs an indemnity note and longer data retention controls. Not asking for custom terms, just temporary credits + eval SLA.

ryan_dealdesk: tagging @mike_ae @amanda_sales — Deal desk rules: standard startup package = 60 days + $10k. Anything above needs deal desk approval with a business case (expected ARR conversion, exec sponsor, references). Send conversion playbook.

amanda_sales: quick draft of business case below: 1) Expected ARR yr1 $180k if POC succeeds 2) Partner pilot with 3 paying customers on roadmap 3) YC reference + intro to 2 similar startups. Request: 90 days + $20k credits + 1 SSO assist ticket.

sarah_finance: finance: credit exceptions must be approved if >$15k. We need an expected CAC payback note and whether credits will be grossed as contra-revenue for reporting. Also need a note on whether they will be on monthly or annual billing after pilot.

natalie_security: security: for SAML we need IdP metadata and a basic SCC (shared controls checklist). We can allow SAML on hosted for 90 days but no persisted PII exports. Also need data retention setting limited to 30 days for the trial. If they need retention >30d, we need a data processing addendum.

josh_se: tech ask: they want KV cache warm start and a dedicated routing policy during demo hours. Can we promise routing priority?

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Related runbook links: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/pilot-routing and https://redwood.internal/pricing/startup-programs

ryan_dealdesk: here's a workable special-term template that deal desk can approve without C-suite signoff: "90d trial, $15k credits applied to usage, one SAML assist (2 engineer-hours), retention capped at 30d; conversion to monthly pay-as-you-go unless commit signed within 90d." If you can accept $15k vs $20k, I can approve today.

amanda_sales: customer pushing for $20k to cover heavy tokens in 90d. They said $15k won't let them test edge cases. Any wiggle room if we add a conversion clause (e.g., if they convert to a $100k ARR commit within 6 months, we retroactively credit $5k)?

sarah_finance: that's fine but we need a clawback clause: credits applied only to usage prior to conversion; retro-credit only if invoices current and conversion executed. Finance ok with contingent $5k rebate on signed commit >=$100k ARR within 6 months.

natalie_security: security ok to proceed with 30d retention + SAML. If legal needs indemnity tweaks we route to legal — won't block pilot.

josh_se: operational note: if we give routing priority, we must flag to infra for capacity. I can set limited priority windows (2x capacity for demo hours) for 2 weeks. Need ops approval.

ryan_dealdesk: final ask to sales: update the business case doc with the contingency commit language and finance/clawback points. If updated, deal desk approves $15k credit + conditional $5k backstop. Also approve one 2-hr SAML assist.

amanda_sales: will update and send CMA (customer merits attachment). One last ask: can we expedite the legal DPA addendum template? They want to sign today.

sarah_finance: legal + finance alignment: legal will push standard DPA. I'll loop in legal and copy you.

amanda_sales: thanks everyone — pushing to customer now. Will post thread update after they accept $15k + contingency. :crossed_fingers:

ops-bot: ticket created: PILOT-4832 — routing priority request queued (ops oncall pinged).
